notes: Transfer milestones for Home's This Week: a small, hand-checked list with the official page each date comes from (read October 25, 2026). Only this cycle's published dates are listed; a later cycle's dates aren't guessed. Add the next cycle once UC, the CSU and CSAC publish it. `system`: UC, CSU, or any (every student). `transfer`: only for students transferring that term. `universities`: only these universities (ASSIST ids); unset = the whole system. `opens`/`closes`: YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific; a milestone shows until the end of `closes`.
